violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Potential complications (26 TAC §746.605(12)(B)(iii))
violation_type.typical_finding: This was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation and found deficient.     Based on information provided in the investigation, it was found that a child had a known history of specific injury and no documentation with instructions of signs or symptoms to look for if the injury were to occur again.
